view.title: ConstructionAdvisor® from enquiry to handover
view.lead: The whole project in one picture: win it, plan and build it, change and claim, then hand it over.

phases.title: Win the work
phases.subtitle: The client, the quote, and the project.

steps.title: Clients
steps.desc: Each client can hold many projects. Issue a client link from here.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 1, Clients. Opens the clients.

steps.title: Quote a project
steps.desc: Start a quote with a title. BOQ lines already on the book are listed under the quotes. Amounts are as entered; the book does not calculate VAT.

chips.label: Issuing a quote to the client launching soon.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 2, Quote a project. Opens the quote a project.
steps.note: Issuing a quote to the client launching soon.

steps.title: Open the project
steps.desc: Contracts, site managers and the status of each project, from tender to practical completion.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 3, Open the project. Opens the open the project.

phases.title: Plan and build
phases.subtitle: The programme, the trades, and the site.

steps.title: Programme
steps.desc: Plan, baseline and actual on a Gantt. An approved variation adds days beside the bar.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 4, Programme. Opens the programme.

steps.title: Trades, materials and drawings
steps.desc: Record the trades on site, the orders and deliveries against the project, and what drawings were issued.

chips.label: Subcontractors have no login and files are not stored yet.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 5, Trades, materials and drawings. Opens the trades, materials and drawings.
steps.note: Subcontractors have no login and files are not stored yet.

steps.title: Site diary and safety
steps.desc: One diary entry per project per day; sign-off locks the day. Toolbox talks, incidents, permits and inductions sit beside it.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 6, Site diary and safety. Opens the site diary and safety.

phases.title: Change and get paid
phases.subtitle: Variations, claims, and costs.

steps.title: Variations
steps.desc: Raise scope and days on site; prices stay with the office.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 7, Variations. Opens the variations.

steps.title: Claims, certificates and costs
steps.desc: Progress claims, a certificate when the office certifies a claim, and actual costs allocated to the project. Amounts are as entered.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 8, Claims, certificates and costs. Opens the claims, certificates and costs.

phases.title: Hand over and report
phases.subtitle: Snags, reports, and the links you issue.

steps.title: Handover and snags
steps.desc: Snags by status. Closing a snag records the day. Photos are not stored.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 9, Handover and snags. Opens the handover and snags.

steps.title: Reports and portals
steps.desc: Per-project reports from the book, with no invented benchmark. The owner issues client and workers links.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 10, Reports and portals. Opens the reports and portals.

guardrails.title: Amounts are as entered
guardrails.body: Quote amounts are shown as entered. This book does not calculate VAT.

guardrails.title: Site manager claims follow the owner switch
guardrails.body: The desk hides claims and certificates from a site manager. When the owner allows workers to see payment amounts, that site manager response includes those claims and certificates again. Costs stay off that response.

guardrails.title: Workers see payment amounts only when the owner turns that on
guardrails.body: The owner can allow workers to see payment amounts. Until that switch is on, those amounts stay off the workers view.

guardrails.title: Sign-off locks the diary day
guardrails.body: Sign-off locks that day. The screen does not edit a signed day.

guardrails.title: There is no subcontractor login
guardrails.body: Subcontractors are a record of the trades on a site. There is no subcontractor login.

view.outcome: The project stays on the book from the enquiry through to handover.

view.statusLine: 8 steps are live, 2 partly live, 0 launching soon

view.title: ApparelAdvisor® from range plan to shipped order
view.lead: Plan the season, make it, sell it against what is available, and ship it. The ship screen shows when release is blocked.

phases.title: Design and cost
phases.subtitle: The season, the styles, the samples and the cost.

steps.title: Range
steps.desc: Seasons and the line plan.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 1, Range. Opens the range.

steps.title: Styles
steps.desc: Style master with colourways and a size curve.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 2, Styles. Opens the styles.

steps.title: Samples
steps.desc: Proto, fit and PP states for each style.

chips.label: View only today. The list shows rows already in the book.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 3, Samples. Opens the samples.
steps.note: View only today. The list shows rows already in the book.

steps.title: Costing
steps.desc: Bill of materials with wastage and landed duty, on the same record as the style.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 4, Costing. Opens the costing.

phases.title: Plan and make
phases.subtitle: The path, the floor and the gates.

steps.title: Critical path
steps.desc: Add a milestone and mark it done, with a planned date and an actual date. The screen names proto, fit, PP, fabric, cut, sew, pack and ship.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 5, Critical path. Opens the critical path.

steps.title: Capability and materials
steps.desc: Line capacity and operators, and the roll register with lot and ownership.

chips.label: View only today.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 6, Capability and materials. Opens the capability and materials.
steps.note: View only today.

steps.title: Floor
steps.desc: Cut and sew tickets by style and quantity.

chips.label: View only today.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 7, Floor. Opens the floor.
steps.note: View only today.

steps.title: Quality gates
steps.desc: Four-point, shade, gold-seal and AQL gates, and whether a QA hold is open.

chips.label: Gate status only. Holds are handled in Quality.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 8, Quality gates. Opens the quality gates.
steps.note: Gate status only. Holds are handled in Quality.

phases.title: Sell and ship
phases.subtitle: Wholesale against what is available, then the ship.

steps.title: Wholesale
steps.desc: Line sheets and prebooks against available-to-sell by style, colour and size. Orders still invoice on Customers Trade.
steps.ariaLabel: Step 9, Wholesale. Opens the wholesale.

steps.title: Ship and reports
steps.desc: Release readiness against lots, purchase orders and open QA holds.

chips.label: Summary only. Lots, purchase orders and holds are managed in Inventory, Suppliers and Quality.

steps.ariaLabel: Step 10, Ship and reports. Opens the ship and reports.
steps.note: Summary only. Lots, purchase orders and holds are managed in Inventory, Suppliers and Quality.

guardrails.title: The ship screen shows when release is blocked
guardrails.body: The ship screen shows release blocked while a four-point, shade, gold-seal or AQL gate fails, while an NBC date is past, or while a QA hold is open. The screen does not stop a shipment.

guardrails.title: Invoices stay on Customers Trade
guardrails.body: Wholesale and costing do not raise an invoice. Invoices stay on Customers Trade.

guardrails.title: The buyer sees the same available-to-sell
guardrails.body: The buyer portal lists the same available-to-sell rows as the wholesale book.

guardrails.title: Some screens only list the book
guardrails.body: Samples, capability, materials and the floor list rows already in the book. They do not add a row.

view.outcome: The season stays on one desk from the range plan through to the ship screen, which shows when release is blocked.
